senses.en: to copy data from a larger system onto your device
a file you have copied onto your device

ex.en: Download the form before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前把表格下载下来。

ex.en: Students who cannot download a large file at home need a copy at school.
ex.zh: 在家下载不了大文件的学生，需要学校里有一份副本。

tip: download 也可作名词。反义常是 upload。

senses.en: an adult male, or humans in general

ex.en: A man from the bookshop helped us find the map.
ex.zh: 书店里的一位男士帮我们找到了那张地图。

ex.en: For most of history, man changed the land slowly; the last century has been different.
ex.zh: 在历史上的大部分时间里，人类改变土地的速度很慢；上一个世纪则不同。

tip: man 泛指人类时较少用于新的正式写作，更常见的是 humans 或 people。

senses.en: the reflexive form of it

ex.en: The door closed by itself.
ex.zh: 门自己关上了。

ex.en: A warning system that fails itself is worse than no system, because people trust it.
ex.zh: 自己失灵的警报系统比没有系统更糟，因为人们信任它。

tip: itself 指事物或动物，不指人。

senses.en: before the usual time
before the expected time

ex.en: I caught the early bus.
ex.zh: 我赶上了早班车。

ex.en: Early support in reading costs less than trying to repair years of failure later.
ex.zh: 早期的阅读帮助，比日后修补多年的失败更省。

tip: early 既可作形容词也可作副词：arrive early。

senses.en: the ability to remember, or something remembered

ex.en: The song brings back a memory of primary school.
ex.zh: 这首歌唤起一段小学的回忆。

ex.en: Public memory of a flood fades unless the photos stay in the library.
ex.zh: 除非照片留在图书馆，否则公众对一场洪水的记忆会消退。

tip: memory 表示记性时多不可数；表示一段回忆时可数。电脑内存也叫 memory。

senses.en: a computer set of instructions, a show, or a plan

ex.en: The program helps students check new words.
ex.zh: 这个程序帮助学生检查生词。

ex.en: A training program for village teachers fails if it requires them to leave their classes for a month.
ex.zh: 如果乡村教师培训计划要求他们离开课堂一个月，这个计划就会失败。

tip: 英式拼写 programme 常指节目或计划；计算机程序英美都常用 program。

senses.en: a plan of how money will be spent
to plan how to spend money

ex.en: The club budget cannot pay for two trips.
ex.zh: 社团预算付不起两次出行。

ex.en: A school budget that forgets heating discovers the mistake in the first cold week.
ex.zh: 忘了供暖的学校预算，会在第一个寒冷的星期发现错误。

tip: budget 作动词是编制预算。

senses.en: for each

ex.en: The room costs twenty yuan per hour.
ex.zh: 这间房间每小时二十元。

ex.en: Cities that measure water use per person can see which habits waste the most.
ex.zh: 按每人用水量统计的城市，能看出哪些习惯最浪费。

tip: per 多用于书面；口语里常用 a 或 every，如 twenty yuan an hour。

senses.en: liked more than others; British spelling
a person or thing you like best

ex.en: This is her favourite seat by the window.
ex.zh: 这是她最喜欢的靠窗座位。

ex.en: A favourite book in the library should have more than one copy.
ex.zh: 图书馆里最受欢迎的书，应当不止一本。

tip: favourite 是英式，favorite 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留，因为考纲里都出现，搜索也只匹配词头。

senses.en: to fix something at the top so the lower part is free

ex.en: Hang the map where everyone can see it.
ex.zh: 把地图挂在大家都能看见的地方。

ex.en: Wet coats that hang in the hallway dry faster than coats left in a pile.
ex.zh: 挂在走廊里的湿外套，比堆成一堆的干得快。

tip: 悬挂的过去式和过去分词是 hung。绞死的过去式是 hanged，本库不展开这个意思。

senses.en: more than usual, or in particular

ex.en: The library is busy, especially before exams.
ex.zh: 图书馆很忙，尤其是考试前。

ex.en: Night buses matter especially for workers who finish after the regular service has stopped.
ex.zh: 夜班公交对那些在常规班次停运后才下班的工人尤其重要。

tip: especially 强调“尤其”；specially 强调“专门地”。

senses.en: a fully grown person

ex.en: An adult must sign the trip form.
ex.zh: 出行表必须由成年人签字。

ex.en: Evening classes give adults a second chance without asking them to leave work.
ex.zh: 夜校给成年人第二次机会，又不必让他们辞去工作。

tip: adult 也可作形容词“成年的”。

senses.en: to show that something is true

ex.en: The experiment did not prove the idea.
ex.zh: 实验没有证明这个想法。

ex.en: One story cannot prove that a whole teaching method works for every school.
ex.zh: 一个故事证明不了一种教学法在每所学校都有效。

tip: 过去式 proved，过去分词 proved 或 proven。prove 后可接形容词：prove useful。

senses.en: a hole, a start, or a job that is free

ex.en: The opening of the clinic is next month.
ex.zh: 诊所下月开业。

ex.en: An opening for a village teacher stays empty if the housing is an hour from the school.
ex.zh: 如果住房离学校一小时，乡村教师的空缺就会一直空着。

tip: opening 是可数名词。

senses.en: the condition of the body or mind

ex.en: Sleep is part of health, not a reward after study.
ex.zh: 睡眠是健康的一部分，不是学完之后的奖赏。

ex.en: Poor air quality is a public health problem, not only a matter of personal choice.
ex.zh: 糟糕的空气质量是公共健康问题，不只是个人选择。

tip: health 不可数。healthy 是形容词。

senses.en: a message sent by computer
to send an e-mail

ex.en: Send the form by e-mail.
ex.zh: 用电子邮件把表发来。

ex.en: An e-mail to the whole school should say who wrote it and how to reply.
ex.zh: 发给全校的电子邮件应当写明是谁写的、如何回复。

tip: e-mail 与 email 同义。mail 已在本库，范围更广，也包括纸质邮件。

senses.en: able to be moved

ex.en: The clinic uses a mobile screen in the hallway.
ex.zh: 诊所在走廊里用一块可移动的屏。

ex.en: A mobile phone in class is useful for a timetable and harmful when it replaces the lesson.
ex.zh: 课堂上的手机对查看课表有用，如果它取代了课本身就有害。

tip: mobile phone 是手机。美式也说 cell phone。形容词 mobile 表示可移动。

senses.en: facts about something

ex.en: The website gives information about bus times.
ex.zh: 网站提供公交时刻的信息。

ex.en: Personal information collected by a school app should not be sold to other companies.
ex.zh: 学校应用收集的个人信息，不该卖给其他公司。

col: a piece of information｜一条信息
tip: information 不可数，不说 an information。

senses.en: something that happens, especially something unusual

ex.en: The incident was written in the log.
ex.zh: 这件事写进了记录。

ex.en: An incident at the gate should name the time, not a guess about who started it.
ex.zh: 门口的事件应当写明时间，而不是猜测谁先动手。

tip: incident 可数。比 accident 更中性，不一定是事故。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: We had a super time at the fair.
ex.zh: 我们在义卖上玩得非常开心。

ex.en: A super stadium does not help a town whose school roof still leaks.
ex.zh: 一座超级体育场帮不了校舍屋顶仍在漏雨的城镇。

tip: super 多用于口语。supermarket 是“超市”。

senses.en: to take in; to hold one's attention

ex.en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
ex.zh: 植物通过根部吸收水分。

senses.en: against the law

ex.en: It is illegal to drive through the playground.
ex.zh: 开车穿过操场是违法的。

ex.en: An illegal dump behind the school is a town problem, not only a bad smell.
ex.zh: 学校后面的非法倾倒是城镇的问题，而不只是一股臭味。

tip: illegal 是形容词。名词是 illegality，不常用。

senses.en: a social gathering, or a political group

ex.en: Our class will have a party on Friday evening.
ex.zh: 我们班周五晚上有聚会。

ex.en: A political party that never meets voters outside election season soon loses their trust.
ex.zh: 只在选举季见选民的政党，很快会失去他们的信任。

tip: party 表示聚会或党派，看语境区分。

senses.en: an occasion when you eat, or the food itself

ex.en: Breakfast is the first meal.
ex.zh: 早饭是第一餐。

ex.en: A hot meal at school can matter more than a speech about diet.
ex.zh: 学校的一顿热饭，可能比一篇关于饮食的讲话更重要。

tip: meal 可数。breakfast、lunch 是具体的餐。

senses.en: a seat for one person

ex.en: Please put the chair back.
ex.zh: 请把椅子放回去。

ex.en: A chair with arms helps some students stand, and it takes more space in a crowded room.
ex.zh: 有扶手的椅子能帮助一些学生站起来，在拥挤的房间里也更占地方。

tip: chair 也可指会议主席。chairman 已在本库。

senses.en: the quality of being hot
to make something hot

ex.en: The heat in the lab made everyone thirsty.
ex.zh: 实验室里的高温让每个人都口渴。

ex.en: Cities store heat in roads and roofs, so a park can be cooler than the street beside it.
ex.zh: 城市把热存在路面和屋顶里，所以公园可以比旁边的街道凉快。

tip: heat 作名词通常不可数。作动词是加热。

senses.en: how someone looks; the act of showing up
an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present

ex.en: First appearance can be misleading.
ex.zh: 第一印象可能具有误导性。

ex.en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
ex.zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。

col: improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

senses.en: the centre
in the centre

ex.en: Stand in the middle of the line.
ex.zh: 站在队伍中间。

ex.en: Shops in the middle of a town keep daily life there when a mall opens on the edge.
ex.zh: 当商场开在城边时，镇中心的商店仍维持着那里的日常生活。

tip: middle 作形容词是“中间的”：middle school。

senses.en: fairly cold, or calm

ex.en: The room is cool in the morning.
ex.zh: 房间早晨很凉快。

ex.en: Cool shade from old trees can matter as much as an air conditioner a school cannot afford.
ex.zh: 老树的凉荫，可以和学校买不起的空调一样重要。

tip: cool 比 cold 程度轻。口语里也可表示“酷”。

senses.en: the leader of a team or a ship

ex.en: She is captain of the school basketball team.
ex.zh: 她是校篮球队队长。

ex.en: A captain who listens before the match can stop a small argument from becoming a lost game.
ex.zh: 开赛前肯听人说话的队长，能避免小争执变成一场输掉的比赛。

tip: captain 也可指海军上校或机长，要看语境。

senses.en: a person or team that wins

ex.en: The winner of the race is in Class 2.
ex.zh: 赛跑的获胜者在二班。

ex.en: Naming only one winner can hide a class project that several students built together.
ex.zh: 只点出一个获胜者，可能掩盖几个学生一起完成的课堂项目。

tip: winner 是人。奖品用 prize 或 award。

senses.en: a large region of a country

ex.en: The province shares one exam timetable.
ex.zh: 这个省共用一份考试时间表。

ex.en: Two provinces that share a river have to share the news of a flood.
ex.zh: 共用一条河的两个省，也必须共享洪水的消息。

tip: province 可数。

senses.en: not difficult

ex.en: The first question is easy.
ex.zh: 第一题很容易。

ex.en: It is easy to blame students for being late when the bus itself never arrives on time.
ex.zh: 当公交本身从不准时，责备学生迟到是容易的。

tip: It is easy for sb to do。

senses.en: suitable, or real and correct

ex.en: Please use the proper bin for paper.
ex.zh: 请把纸放进对应的桶。

ex.en: A proper lunch is more than a packet eaten while walking to the next class.
ex.zh: 一顿像样的午饭不只是走向下一节课时吃掉的一包东西。

tip: proper 放在名词前。properly 是副词。

senses.en: an object, fact, or action

ex.en: The first thing I do is open the windows.
ex.zh: 我做的第一件事是开窗。

ex.en: The hardest thing about changing a habit is not the first day but the quiet week that follows.
ex.zh: 改变一个习惯最难的不是第一天，而是之后安静的那一周。

tip: thing 很宽泛；写作里能用更具体的名词时尽量换掉。

senses.en: the feeling of being afraid
to be afraid of

ex.en: Her fear of the dark road is reasonable.
ex.zh: 她对那条黑路的害怕是合理的。

ex.en: Fear of a late bus should lead a town to change the timetable, not to blame the student.
ex.zh: 对晚点公交的担忧应该促使城镇改时刻表，而不是责备学生。

tip: fear 作动词是“害怕”：fear that。

senses.en: to like one thing more than another

ex.en: I prefer tea to coffee.
ex.zh: 我喜欢茶胜过咖啡。

ex.en: Students who prefer a quiet seat should not have to arrive first to get one.
ex.zh: 更喜欢安静座位的学生，不应当必须最先到才能得到。

col: prefer A to B｜喜欢 A 胜过 B
tip: prefer A to B，不用 than。prefer to do rather than do 也可以。

senses.en: lasting for a long time or forever

ex.en: The mark on the wall is not permanent.
ex.zh: 墙上的痕迹不是永久的。

ex.en: A permanent bus stop is more useful than a promise that changes every term.
ex.zh: 一个固定的公交站，比每个学期都变的承诺更有用。

tip: permanent 的反义是 temporary。

senses.en: a person who receives guests, or who presents a show
to organize an event or receive guests

ex.en: Our host showed us where to sit.
ex.zh: 主人带我们找到座位。

ex.en: A host city for a school games meeting needs beds as well as a stadium.
ex.zh: 承办校际运动会的城市需要床位，而不只是一座体育场。

tip: host 作动词是主办或招待。a host of 表示许多。

senses.en: the quality of being beautiful

ex.en: The beauty of the lake is in the morning light.
ex.zh: 湖的美在晨光里。

ex.en: A city can protect the beauty of an old street and still make the pavement safe.
ex.zh: 一座城市可以保护老街的美，同时把人行道修安全。

tip: beauty 通常不可数。a beauty 可指美丽的人或物，要看语境。

senses.en: the opening in the face used for eating and speaking

ex.en: Cover your mouth when you cough.
ex.zh: 咳嗽时捂住嘴。

ex.en: The mouth of the river is where the town's waste becomes the sea's problem.
ex.zh: 河口是城镇的废物变成海洋问题的地方。

tip: mouth 可指嘴，也可指河口或容器口。

senses.en: not far away

ex.en: There is a nearby shop that sells notebooks.
ex.zh: 附近有一家卖笔记本的店。

ex.en: A nearby clinic is useful only if it is open after school.
ex.zh: 附近的诊所只有在放学后还开着时才有用。

tip: nearby 也可作副词，放在动词后：live nearby。

senses.en: the main support or reason
The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.

ex.en: Trust is the basis of friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是友谊的基础。

ex.en: Reliable evidence should provide the basis for government decisions about public health and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 可靠的证据应成为政府作出公共卫生和环境保护决策的依据。

col: form the basis of｜构成……的基础
tip: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

senses.en: to spend time learning
the activity of studying

ex.en: I study English for twenty minutes a day.
ex.zh: 我每天学二十分钟英语。

ex.en: Students study better in a room that is quiet than in one filled with traffic noise.
ex.zh: 学生在安静的房间里比在充满交通噪音的房间里学得更好。

tip: study 强调系统学习；learn 强调学会。

senses.en: the money or effort needed
to have a price

ex.en: The cost of the trip is fifty yuan.
ex.zh: 这次出行的费用是五十元。

ex.en: The cost of dirty air does not appear on a shop receipt, but it appears in hospital visits.
ex.zh: 脏空气的代价不会出现在购物小票上，但会出现在医院就诊里。

col: at the cost of｜以……为代价
tip: cost 作动词的过去式仍是 cost。sth costs sb money。

senses.en: any thing at all

ex.en: Is there anything I can do to help?
ex.zh: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

ex.en: If a report hides anything important, the public cannot judge whether a project deserves support.
ex.zh: 如果一份报告隐瞒了重要内容，公众就无法判断一个项目是否值得支持。

tip: anything 常用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句中的“某事”用 something。

senses.en: a hot sausage in a long piece of bread

ex.en: He bought a hot dog after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后他买了一个热狗。

ex.en: A hot dog at a school fair is a small sale, and the queue still needs a clear price.
ex.zh: 学校义卖上的热狗是小买卖，队伍前面仍然需要标明清价格。

tip: hot dog 是食物，不是狗。两个词都要写。

senses.en: a sweet brown food

ex.en: The chocolate is for the whole class.
ex.zh: 巧克力是给全班的。

ex.en: Chocolate that hides nuts should say so on the label.
ex.zh: 藏着坚果的巧克力应当在标签上写明。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一条巧克力
tip: chocolate 作物质名词通常不可数。

senses.en: how big something is

ex.en: What size are these shoes?
ex.zh: 这双鞋是多大尺码？

ex.en: The size of a class changes what one teacher can notice during a lesson.
ex.zh: 班级的大小会改变一位老师在课上能注意到什么。

tip: size 前常用 what 提问尺码。

senses.en: of whom or of which

ex.en: Whose bag is this?
ex.zh: 这是谁的包？

ex.en: A town whose only clinic closes will send every night emergency onto a dark road.
ex.zh: 唯一诊所关闭的城镇，会把每个夜间急诊都送到一条黑暗的路上。

tip: whose 可指人也可指物，用来表示所属。

senses.en: the ability to see, or something you see

ex.en: The test checks sight, not only reading.
ex.zh: 这次检查的是视力，不只是阅读。

ex.en: The sight of a late bus is a relief only if it still stops here.
ex.zh: 看见晚班车令人宽慰，前提是它仍然在这里停。

tip: in sight 表示看得见。表里这一行的音标是 sigh，本库不用。

senses.en: not large

ex.en: We need a small room for the group discussion.
ex.zh: 小组讨论我们需要一间小房间。

ex.en: A small change in bus times can decide whether a student arrives before the first lesson.
ex.zh: 公交时间的一个小改动，就能决定学生是否赶得上第一节课。

tip: small 强调尺寸不大；little 常带感情色彩。

senses.en: a person who speaks for a group
typical of a group

ex.en: Each class sent one representative.
ex.zh: 每个班派了一名代表。

ex.en: A representative who never asks the class is only a name on a list.
ex.zh: 从不询问班级的代表，只是名单上的一个名字。

tip: represent 是本批的动词。representative 作形容词是有代表性的。

senses.en: physical games and exercise

ex.en: Sport is part of the timetable on Friday.
ex.zh: 周五的课表里有体育。

ex.en: School sport should include students who are not trying to win a cup.
ex.zh: 学校体育应当包括那些并不想去夺杯的学生。

tip: sport 作总称时常不可数。具体项目可用 a sport。英式运动会常用 sports。

senses.en: the organ of thought

ex.en: Sleep helps the brain keep new words.
ex.zh: 睡眠帮助大脑记住生词。

ex.en: A tired brain makes careless mistakes, which is why a late bus is also a learning problem.
ex.zh: 疲惫的大脑会犯粗心错误，所以晚点的公交也是学习问题。

tip: brain 是可数名词。

senses.en: damage or injury
to hurt

ex.en: The smoke did no lasting harm.
ex.zh: 这烟没有造成持久的伤害。

ex.en: Harm from a rumour can last longer than the speaker expects.
ex.zh: 谣言造成的伤害可能比说话的人预计的更久。

col: there is no harm in｜……没有坏处
tip: harm 作动词是伤害。通常不可数。

senses.en: a round object used in games, or a formal dance

ex.en: The ball went over the fence.
ex.zh: 球飞过了篱笆。

ex.en: A lost ball is a small cost; a playground with no space to play is a larger one.
ex.zh: 丢一个球是小代价；没有地方玩的操场是更大的代价。

tip: ball 表示球是可数名词。

senses.en: to say you will certainly do something
a statement that you will do something

ex.en: I promise to return the book on Monday.
ex.zh: 我保证周一还书。

ex.en: A city should not promise a new library until it has named the building and the staff.
ex.zh: 在确定房子和人员之前，城市不应当承诺一座新图书馆。

tip: promise 后接 to do 或 that。名词也是 promise。

senses.en: not changing, or in agreement

ex.en: The two notices are not consistent.
ex.zh: 两则通知不一致。

ex.en: A consistent bus time is more useful than a new colour on the sign.
ex.zh: 稳定的公交时间比牌子上的新颜色更有用。

tip: consistent with something。

senses.en: special, or one certain thing

ex.en: Is there a particular bus you take?
ex.zh: 你坐某一路特定的公交吗？

ex.en: A particular street may flood every year while the official map still calls the area safe.
ex.zh: 某一条街可能每年都积水，而官方地图仍称该地区安全。

tip: particular 强调某一个；special 强调与众不同。

senses.en: to search carefully, or to chase wild animals
a search, or the chasing of animals

ex.en: We hunted for the key for ten minutes.
ex.zh: 我们找了十分钟钥匙。

ex.en: The history text mentions a hunt only as a custom, not as a method.
ex.zh: 历史课文提到狩猎，只把它当作一种习俗，而不是方法。

tip: hunt for 是寻找。狩猎义本条不写操作。

senses.en: a subject or situation
to be important

ex.en: This is a serious matter.
ex.zh: 这是一件严肃的事。

ex.en: Housing is not a private matter when high rents push workers far from the jobs a city needs.
ex.zh: 当高房租把工人推离城市需要的工作时，住房就不是私事。

col: as a matter of fact｜事实上
tip: matter 作动词是“要紧”：It matters。no matter 后接 who、what、how。

senses.en: an organization that provides a service

ex.en: The travel agency changed our train tickets.
ex.zh: 旅行社改了我们的火车票。

ex.en: A housing agency that hides fees makes it harder for young workers to compare real costs.
ex.zh: 隐瞒费用的房屋中介，会让年轻工人更难比较真实成本。

tip: agency 是机构，agent 是里面办事的人或代理人。

senses.en: to guide, or to cause a result
a leading position, or a soft metal

ex.en: The monitor will lead us to the hall.
ex.zh: 班长会带我们去大厅。

ex.en: Poor bus links can lead families to buy cars they can hardly afford.
ex.zh: 糟糕的公交连接会促使家庭去买他们几乎负担不起的汽车。

tip: lead 的过去式和过去分词是 led，不是 leaded。作名词“铅”或“领先”时读音不同。

senses.en: an organised group, or a connection

ex.en: The parents' association paid for the new books.
ex.zh: 家长协会付了新书的钱。

ex.en: The association between night noise and poor sleep is clear in streets beside a main road.
ex.zh: 夜间噪音和睡眠差之间的联系，在主干道旁的街道上很清楚。

tip: association 可指组织，也可指事物之间的关联。

senses.en: to start

ex.en: The meeting will begin at eight.
ex.zh: 会议八点开始。

ex.en: Cities should begin flood practice before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
ex.zh: 城市应当在雨季之前开始防汛演练，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。

tip: begin 的过去式是 began，过去分词是 begun。to begin with 表示首先。

senses.en: to pay no attention to

ex.en: Do not ignore the broken step.
ex.zh: 不要忽视坏掉的台阶。

ex.en: Cities that ignore the last bus will hear about it from parents.
ex.zh: 忽视末班车的城市，会从家长那里听到这件事。

tip: ignore 后直接接宾语，不说 ignore about。

senses.en: as much or as many as needed

ex.en: There is enough paper for everyone.
ex.zh: 纸够每个人用。

ex.en: It is not enough to build a cycle lane if it ends at the busiest crossing without a light.
ex.zh: 如果自行车道在最繁忙的路口没有信号灯就中断，仅仅修建它是不够的。

tip: enough 放在形容词和副词后面：old enough；放在名词前面：enough time。

senses.en: a person who designs or builds machines or structures

ex.en: An engineer checked the roof.
ex.zh: 一位工程师检查了屋顶。

ex.en: The engineer who designs the crossing should walk it at the hour students leave.
ex.zh: 设计路口的工程师应当在学生离校的那个钟点走一遍。

tip: engine 已在本库。engineer 是设计或修建的人。

senses.en: a group of students, a lesson, or a social group

ex.en: Our class meets in Room 12.
ex.zh: 我们班在 12 室上课。

ex.en: A class of forty is hard to teach well if one teacher has no assistant.
ex.zh: 如果一位老师没有助手，四十人的班很难教好。

tip: class 表示课堂时 in class 不加 the。

senses.en: a part in a play, or a function

ex.en: She played the role of the teacher in the play.
ex.zh: 她在剧里扮演老师。

ex.en: Buses play a role in school life that a wider road cannot replace.
ex.zh: 公交在学校生活中的作用，是更宽的马路替代不了的。

col: play a role in｜在……中起作用
tip: play a role in 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: to continue to live or exist

ex.en: The plant survived the frost.
ex.zh: 这棵植物在霜冻后活了下来。

ex.en: A small shop survives when the rent stays possible, not only when the poster is bright.
ex.zh: 小店能留下来，是因为租金仍然付得起，而不只是因为海报鲜亮。

tip: survive 可及物：survive a flood。也可不及物。

senses.en: not many

ex.en: Few students finished the last question.
ex.zh: 很少有学生做完最后一题。

ex.en: A few trees on a hot street help, but they cannot replace a park.
ex.zh: 炎热街道上的几棵树有帮助，但替代不了一座公园。

tip: few 偏否定，几乎没有；a few 表示有一些。都用于可数名词。

senses.en: a state in which weight or importance is equal
to keep something steady, or to weigh options

ex.en: Try to keep a balance between study and sleep.
ex.zh: 尽量在学习和睡眠之间保持平衡。

ex.en: A city budget is a balance between a new road and the clinic that already needs repairs.
ex.zh: 城市预算是在新路和已经需要维修的诊所之间做平衡。

tip: balance 作动词是权衡或使平衡。

senses.en: a nation, or land outside towns

ex.en: Students from five countries joined the online class.
ex.zh: 来自五个国家的学生参加了网课。

ex.en: People leave the country for the city when schools and clinics there are too far apart.
ex.zh: 当乡村的学校和诊所彼此离得太远时，人们会离开乡村去城市。

tip: country 表示国家时可数；the country 常指乡村。

senses.en: to know the meaning of something

ex.en: I understand the question now.
ex.zh: 我现在明白这道题了。

ex.en: Planners understand a neighbourhood better when they walk it at the hour children leave school.
ex.zh: 规划者如果在孩子放学的时刻走过一个社区，会理解得更好。

tip: understand 的过去式仍是 understand，不是 understanded。

senses.en: a title used before a man's surname

ex.en: Mr. Li starts the lesson at eight.
ex.zh: 李老师八点开始上课。

ex.en: A letter that begins with the wrong title, such as Mr. for a woman, can undo an otherwise polite request.
ex.zh: 一封信如果称谓用错，比如对女性用 Mr.，再礼貌的请求也会被削弱。

tip: Mr. 后接姓，不接名。书写时通常作 Mr.。

senses.en: pleasing, or able to draw interest

ex.en: The poster is attractive, but the time is wrong.
ex.zh: 海报好看，但时间写错了。

ex.en: An attractive fare is useless if the last bus does not stop here.
ex.zh: 如果末班车不在这里停，好看的票价也没用。

tip: attract 已在本库。attractive 不要只用在外貌上。

senses.en: safety, or the people who guard a place

ex.en: The school improved security at the gate.
ex.zh: 学校加强了校门的安保。

ex.en: Food security means a town can still eat when one road is closed by a flood.
ex.zh: 粮食安全意味着一条路被洪水封闭时，城镇仍然吃得上饭。

tip: security 通常不可数。

senses.en: shared customs and arts
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: Food is part of local culture.
ex.zh: 食物是当地文化的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: an opinion, or what can be seen
to look at, or to consider

ex.en: What is your view on the new timetable?
ex.zh: 你对新课表有什么看法？

ex.en: A fine view of the river does not show whether the water is safe to drink.
ex.zh: 好看的河景并不能说明水是否可以安全饮用。

tip: view 作动词是“观看”或“视为”。

senses.en: to stop living

ex.en: The flowers die if nobody waters them.
ex.zh: 如果没人浇水，花就会死。

ex.en: Fish die in a river long before the colour of the water warns the town.
ex.zh: 鱼会在水色警告城镇之前很久就死在河里。

tip: die 是不及物动词，不能说 die sb。过去式是 died。

senses.en: to win against someone
a loss

ex.en: The team did not defeat anyone; the match was cancelled.
ex.zh: 队伍没有击败任何人，比赛取消了。

ex.en: A defeat on the field should not decide who may use the library.
ex.zh: 场上的失败不应当决定谁可以使用图书馆。

tip: defeat 作名词是失败。比 fail 更常用于比赛或战争。

senses.en: a photograph, a kick or throw at a goal, or an injection

ex.en: She took a shot of the old bridge.
ex.zh: 她给那座旧桥拍了一张照片。

ex.en: A last-minute shot can win a match, but a team still needs a plan for the whole game.
ex.zh: 最后一秒的投篮可以赢得比赛，但球队仍需要整场比赛的计划。

tip: shot 也是 shoot 的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: a reason you give to explain a fault
to forgive

ex.en: Tiredness is not an excuse for a locked fire door.
ex.zh: 疲劳不是锁上防火门的借口。

ex.en: Please excuse the delay; the bus was late and the notice said so.
ex.zh: 请原谅这次耽误；公交晚了，通知里也写了。

tip: 名词借口常读 /ɪkˈskjuːs/，动词原谅常读 /ɪkˈskjuːz/。表里给的是动词读音。

senses.en: not thin, or not flowing easily

ex.en: The coat is thick enough for this wind.
ex.zh: 这件外套够厚，能挡这种风。

ex.en: Thick smoke in a hallway is a reason to leave, not to look for a bag.
ex.zh: 走廊里的浓烟是离开的理由，不是找包的理由。

tip: thick 可形容物体、液体或烟雾。

senses.en: acceptable

ex.en: Is it okay if I borrow your ruler?
ex.zh: 我借你的尺子可以吗？

ex.en: An okay-looking timetable still fails students if the last bus leaves before school ends.
ex.zh: 看起来没问题的时刻表，如果末班车在放学前离开，仍然会让学生失望。

tip: okay 与 O.K. 是同一个词。本库只保留 okay。正式写作可用 all right。

senses.en: younger or lower in rank
Intended for younger people or involving them
A younger person, or a student below the final year

ex.en: He is a junior member of the team.
ex.zh: 他是队里的初级成员。

ex.en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
ex.zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。

tip: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

senses.en: in a true way, or sincerely

ex.en: I am truly sorry for the delay.
ex.zh: 这次耽误我真的很抱歉。

ex.en: A programme is truly open only when students without a laptop can still take part.
ex.zh: 只有没有笔记本电脑的学生也能参加时，一个项目才真正开放。

tip: 信末 Yours truly 是客套结尾。truly 强调真实，不只是程度很高。

senses.en: a flat dish, or a flat piece

ex.en: Put the plate in the sink.
ex.zh: 把盘子放进水槽。

ex.en: A cracked plate in the canteen should be thrown away the same day.
ex.zh: 食堂里裂了的盘子应当当天扔掉。

tip: plate 也可指金属板或车牌。

senses.en: with each other

ex.en: We cleaned the classroom together.
ex.zh: 我们一起打扫了教室。

ex.en: Neighbours who cook together waste less food than families who each buy too much.
ex.zh: 一起做饭的邻居，比各自买得太多的家庭浪费的食物更少。

tip: together 是副词，不单独作动词。

senses.en: the process of making things, or the amount made

ex.en: Food production fell after the dry month.
ex.zh: 干旱的一个月之后，食品产量下降了。

ex.en: Higher production of plastic does not help if the town has nowhere to put the waste.
ex.zh: 如果城镇没有地方放置废物，更高的塑料产量也没有帮助。

tip: production 通常不可数。

senses.en: a place, a job, or an opinion

ex.en: Write your position in the team on the form.
ex.zh: 在表格上写你在队里的位置。

ex.en: A city's position on housing decides who can live near work and who must travel for hours.
ex.zh: 一座城市在住房上的立场，决定谁能住在工作附近，谁必须赶几小时的路。

tip: in a position to do 表示有条件做某事。

senses.en: of the colour of earth or coffee
the colour brown

ex.en: He carried a brown bag.
ex.zh: 他拿着一个棕色的包。

ex.en: Brown flood water in a street is a warning, not a picture to share without context.
ex.zh: 街上的棕色洪水是警报，不是可以不说明背景就转发的照片。

tip: brown 也可作名词表示棕色。

senses.en: of the Olympic Games

ex.en: The Olympic story is on the wall.
ex.zh: 奥林匹克的故事在墙上。

ex.en: An Olympic poster does not replace a field the school can actually use.
ex.zh: 一张奥林匹克海报代替不了学校真正能用的场地。

col: the Olympic Games｜奥林匹克运动会
tip: Olympic 要大写。Olympics 是本批的另一词，指奥运会。

senses.en: to use money or time

ex.en: I spend twenty minutes on new words.
ex.zh: 我花二十分钟学生词。

ex.en: Families spend a larger share of their income on food when prices rise.
ex.zh: 物价上涨时，家庭把收入中更大的一份花在食物上。

tip: spend 的主语是人。It takes time 的主语是事物。过去式是 spent。

senses.en: a repeated design, or a regular way something happens

ex.en: The pattern on the cloth is simple.
ex.zh: 布上的图案很简单。

ex.en: A pattern of late buses is a fact, not one unlucky day.
ex.zh: 公交一再晚点是一个事实，不是倒霉的一天。

tip: pattern 可数。作动词是仿造。

senses.en: to make it easier for someone to do something
the act of helping

ex.en: Could you help me move this desk?
ex.zh: 你能帮我搬这张桌子吗？

ex.en: Older students can help younger ones settle in, which also builds leadership in the older group.
ex.zh: 高年级学生可以帮助新生适应，这也能培养他们的领导能力。

col: help sb with｜在某方面帮助
with the help of｜在……帮助下
tip: help sb (to) do 中的 to 可以省略。

senses.en: the one belonging to you

ex.en: This seat is yours if you want it.
ex.zh: 如果你要，这个座位是你的。

ex.en: Yours sincerely is a safe ending when you know the name but not the person well.
ex.zh: 知道对方姓名但并不熟时，Yours sincerely 是稳妥的信末用语。

tip: 名词性物主代词，后面不再接名词。your 是限定词，本库未单列。

senses.en: tall, or great in amount or level

ex.en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
ex.zh: 架子太高，我够不着。

ex.en: High housing costs near good schools can shut out the families those schools were meant to serve.
ex.zh: 好学校附近的高房价，可能把学校本应服务的家庭挡在外面。

tip: 人的个子用 tall；山、价格、水平用 high。
